name: syncing-app-settings
description: Capture a Mac app's current preferences from its macOS defaults domain into the module's `defaults.sh`, which the module's `install.sh` runs. Use when Josh says 'sync the settings for <app>', 'sync <app>'s settings', 'pull <app>'s preferences into the repo', 'capture my <app> settings', or 'add defaults for <app>'. Covers refreshing an existing module's `defaults.sh` and adding one for an app that has none. Apps whose settings live in a file rather than a defaults domain are out of scope.

findings.excerpt: defaults read <domain>              # every key the app has stored
